barriers.description: Barriers to general business activities or performance, 2024-25 financial year (BCS data cube 1, Table 6): per cent of businesses reporting each barrier, by innovation status, employment size (persons), ANZSIC division, state and location. Columns: economic_uncertainty = Uncertainty about economic conditions; supply_chain = Supply chain issues; lack_of_funds = Lack of access to additional funds; cost_of_inputs = Cost of inputs; accounts_receivable = Outstanding accounts receivable limiting cash flow; internet_access = Internet access issues; skills_within_business = Lack of skilled persons: within the business; skills_labour_market = Lack of skilled persons: within the labour market; skills_any = Lack of skilled persons: any lack of skilled persons; government_regulation = Government regulations and/or compliance; lack_of_demand = Lack of customer demand for goods or services; lower_margins = Lower profit margins to remain competitive; environmental = Environmental factors; other = Other factors; none = No hampering factors.

competition.description: Amount of competition experienced, 2024-25 financial year (BCS data cube 1, Table 7): per cent of businesses, by employment size (persons), ANZSIC division, state and location. Columns: no_effective_competition = None/captive market/no effective competition; one_or_two = One or two competitors; three_or_four = Three or four competitors; five_or_more = Five or more competitors.
